verses.original: Καὶ τῇ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ γάμος ἐγένετο ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἡ μήτηρ ἦν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai tē tē tritē hēmera gamos egeneto en Kana tēs Galilaias kai tou Iēsou hē mētēr ēn ekei
verses.literal: - On the - third day a wedding took place at Cana - in Galilee - - Jesus’ - mother was there

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐκλήθη καὶ εἰς τὸν γάμον
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous kai autou hoi mathētai eklēthē kai eis ton gamon
verses.literal: and - Jesus and His - disciples had also been invited . . . to the wedding

verses.original: καὶ οἴνου ὑστερήσαντος ἡ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ μήτηρ λέγει πρὸς αὐτόν ἔχουσιν οὐκ Οἶνον
verses.transliteration: kai oinou hysterēsantos hē tou Iēsou mētēr legei pros auton echousin ouk Oinon
verses.literal: When [the] wine ran out - - Jesus’ mother said to Him They have no more wine

verses.original: γύναι Τί σοί καὶ ἐμοὶ Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῇ μου ἡ ὥρα οὔπω ἥκει
verses.transliteration: gynai Ti soi kai emoi Kai ho Iēsous legei autē mou hē hōra oupō hēkei
verses.literal: Woman what [is that] to you and to Me - - Jesus replied - My - hour {has} not yet come

verses.original: αὐτοῦ ἡ μήτηρ Λέγει τοῖς διακόνοις ποιήσατε Ὅ τι ἂν λέγῃ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: autou hē mētēr Legei tois diakonois poiēsate Ho ti an legē hymin
verses.literal: His - mother said to the servants Do whatever . . . . . . He tells you

verses.original: δὲ ἓξ λίθιναι ὑδρίαι Ἦσαν κείμεναι ἐκεῖ κατὰ τῶν Ἰουδαίων τὸν καθαρισμὸν χωροῦσαι ἀνὰ δύο ἢ τρεῖς μετρητὰς
verses.transliteration: de hex lithinai hydriai Ēsan keimenai ekei kata tōn Ioudaiōn ton katharismon chōrousai ana dyo ē treis metrētas
verses.literal: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish - [rites of] purification [Each] could hold from twenty to thirty gallons . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Γεμίσατε τὰς ὑδρίας ὕδατος Καὶ ἐγέμισαν αὐτὰς ἕως ἄνω
verses.transliteration: Iēsous legei autois ho Gemisate tas hydrias hydatos Kai egemisan autas heōs anō
verses.literal: Jesus told [the servants] - Fill the jars with water So they filled them to [the] brim

verses.original: νῦν Ἀντλήσατε Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς καὶ φέρετε τῷ ἀρχιτρικλίνῳ Οἱ δὲ ἤνεγκαν
verses.transliteration: nyn Antlēsate Kai legei autois kai pherete tō architriklinō Hoi de ēnenkan
verses.literal: Now draw [some] out - He said - and take [it] to the master of the banquet - - They [did so]

verses.original: δὲ ὡς ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος ἐγεύσατο τὸ ὕδωρ γεγενημένον οἶνον καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει πόθεν ἐστίν δὲ οἱ διάκονοι οἱ ἠντληκότες τὸ ὕδωρ ᾔδεισαν ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος φωνεῖ τὸν νυμφίον
verses.transliteration: de hōs ho architriklinos egeusato to hydōr gegenēmenon oinon kai ouk ēdei pothen estin de hoi diakonoi hoi ēntlēkotes to hydōr ēdeisan ho architriklinos phōnei ton nymphion
verses.literal: and - the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine - vvv He did not know where it was {from} but the servants who had drawn the water knew Then [he] called the bridegroom [aside]

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Πᾶς ἄνθρωπος τίθησιν τὸν καλὸν οἶνον πρῶτον καὶ τὸν ἐλάσσω ὅταν μεθυσθῶσιν σὺ τετήρηκας τὸν καλὸν οἶνον ἕως ἄρτι
verses.transliteration: kai legei autō Pas anthrōpos tithēsin ton kalon oinon prōton kai ton elassō hotan methysthōsin sy tetērēkas ton kalon oinon heōs arti
verses.literal: and said - Everyone - serves the fine wine first and then the cheap [wine] after [the guests] are drunk [But] you have saved the fine wine until now

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς ἐποίησεν Ταύτην ἀρχὴν τῶν σημείων ὁ ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐφανέρωσεν τὴν αὐτοῦ δόξαν καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Iēsous epoiēsen Tautēn archēn tōn sēmeiōn ho en Kana tēs Galilaias kai ephanerōsen tēn autou doxan kai autou hoi mathētai episteusan eis auton
verses.literal: Jesus performed this the first of His signs - at Cana - in Galilee He thus revealed - His glory and His - disciples believed in Him

verses.original: Μετὰ τοῦτο κατέβη εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ αὐτοῦ μήτηρ καὶ οἱ αὐτοῦ ἀδελφοὶ καὶ οἱ αὐτοῦ μαθηταὶ καὶ ἔμειναν ἐκεῖ οὐ πολλὰς ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: Meta touto katebē eis Kapharnaoum autos kai hē autou mētēr kai hoi autou adelphoi kai hoi autou mathētai kai emeinan ekei ou pollas hēmeras
verses.literal: After this He went down to Capernaum - [with] - His mother and - - brothers and - His disciples and they stayed there vvv a few days

verses.original: Καὶ τὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων πάσχα ἦν ἐγγὺς καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνέβη εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Kai to tōn Ioudaiōn pascha ēn engys kai ho Iēsous anebē eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: When the vvv Jewish Passover was near - - Jesus went up to Jerusalem

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ εὗρεν τοὺς πωλοῦντας βόας καὶ πρόβατα καὶ περιστερὰς καὶ τοὺς κερματιστὰς καθημένους
verses.transliteration: kai en tō hierō heuren tous pōlountas boas kai probata kai peristeras kai tous kermatistas kathēmenous
verses.literal: - In the temple [courts] He found [men] selling cattle - sheep and doves and - money changers seated [at their tables]

verses.original: καὶ ποιήσας φραγέλλιον ἐκ σχοινίων ἐξέβαλεν πάντας ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ τε τά πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς βόας καὶ ἐξέχεεν τὰ κέρματα τῶν κολλυβιστῶν καὶ ἀνέτρεψεν τὰς τραπέζας
verses.transliteration: kai poiēsas phragellion ek schoiniōn exebalen pantas ek tou hierou te ta probata kai tous boas kai execheen ta kermata tōn kollybistōn kai anetrepsen tas trapezas
verses.literal: [So] He made a whip out of cords [and] drove all from the temple [courts] both - sheep and - cattle - He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned [their] tables

verses.original: καὶ τοῖς πωλοῦσιν τὰς περιστερὰς εἶπεν Ἄρατε ταῦτα ἐντεῦθεν μὴ ποιεῖτε μου τοῦ Πατρός τὸν οἶκον οἶκον ἐμπορίου
verses.transliteration: kai tois pōlousin tas peristeras eipen Arate tauta enteuthen mē poieite mou tou Patros ton oikon oikon emporiou
verses.literal: - To those selling - doves He said Get these out of here How dare you turn My - Father’s - house {into} a marketplace . . .

verses.original: αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ Ἐμνήσθησαν ὅτι ἐστίν γεγραμμένον Ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ σου οἴκου καταφάγεταί με
verses.transliteration: autou hoi mathētai Emnēsthēsan hoti estin gegrammenon Ho zēlos tou sou oikou kataphagetai me
verses.literal: His - disciples remembered that it is written - Zeal for Your house will consume Me

verses.original: οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Τί σημεῖον δεικνύεις ἡμῖν ὅτι ποιεῖς ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: oun hoi Ioudaioi Apekrithēsan kai eipan autō Ti sēmeion deiknyeis hēmin hoti poieis tauta
verses.literal: On account of this the Jews demanded . . . . . . . . . What sign can You show us to prove Your [ authority ] to do these things

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίθη καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Λύσατε τοῦτον τὸν ναὸν καὶ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερῶ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Iēsous Apekrithē kai eipen autois Lysate touton ton naon kai en trisin hēmerais egerō auton
verses.literal: Jesus answered . . . . . . . . . Destroy this - temple and in three days I will raise it up again . . .

verses.original: οὗτος ὁ ναὸς Τεσσεράκοντα καὶ ἓξ ἔτεσιν οἰκοδομήθη οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Εἶπαν καὶ σὺ ἐγερεῖς αὐτόν ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις
verses.transliteration: houtos ho naos Tesserakonta kai hex etesin oikodomēthē oun hoi Ioudaioi Eipan kai sy egereis auton en trisin hēmerais
verses.literal: This - temple {took} forty-six . . . . . . years to build - the Jews replied and You are going to raise it up . . . in three days

verses.original: δὲ Ἐκεῖνος ἔλεγεν περὶ τοῦ ναοῦ αὐτοῦ τοῦ σώματος
verses.transliteration: de Ekeinos elegen peri tou naou autou tou sōmatos
verses.literal: But [Jesus] was speaking about the temple [of] His - body

verses.original: οὖν ὅτε ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐμνήσθησαν ὅτι ἔλεγεν τοῦτο καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τῇ γραφῇ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ ὃν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: oun hote ēgerthē ek nekrōn autou hoi mathētai emnēsthēsan hoti elegen touto kai episteusan tē graphē kai tō logō hon ho Iēsous eipen
verses.literal: - After He was raised from [the] dead His - disciples remembered that He had said this Then they believed the Scripture and the word that - Jesus had spoken

verses.original: δὲ Ὡς ἦν ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῷ πάσχα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ πολλοὶ θεωροῦντες αὐτοῦ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτοῦ τὸ ὄνομα
verses.transliteration: de Hōs ēn en tois Hierosolymois en tō pascha en tē heortē polloi theōrountes autou ta sēmeia ha epoiei episteusan eis autou to onoma
verses.literal: - While He was in - Jerusalem at the Passover - - Feast many people saw [the] - signs - He was doing [and] believed in His - name

verses.original: δὲ Ἰησοῦς αὐτὸς οὐκ ἐπίστευεν αὑτὸν αὐτοῖς διὰ αὐτὸν τὸ γινώσκειν πάντας
verses.transliteration: de Iēsous autos ouk episteuen hauton autois dia auton to ginōskein pantas
verses.literal: But Jesus . . . {did} not entrust Himself to them for He - knew [them] all

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι εἶχεν οὐ χρείαν ἵνα τις μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου γὰρ αὐτὸς ἐγίνωσκεν τί ἦν ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ
verses.transliteration: kai hoti eichen ou chreian hina tis martyrēsē peri tou anthrōpou gar autos eginōsken ti ēn en tō anthrōpō
verses.literal: - - He {did} not need - any testimony about - man for He knew what was in - [a] man
